shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright slab/pillar with rounded top
repeated row of similar motifs across the upper part
surface covered edge-to-edge with figural relief
justification: Both are upright slabs carved in low relief with animal-derived imagery filling the whole face, including a row of repeated creatures across the top and profile heads with large eyes, which is a generic rather than diagnostic correspondence. A depicts discrete, recognizable naturalistic animals (quadrupeds, a bird, a fox-like beast) and a small human-like figure isolated against blank ground with clear separating bands, whereas B is a dense, abstracted interlocking scrollwork of curvilinear glyph-like elements with no empty ground or naturalistic bodies.
